Name: Cosmetic Vanilla Boots
Author: Nekotekina
Description:
For those like me who like playing with a lot of different clothing, this mod intends to make your life easier. I've always found it a hassle to have to depend on rare drop rates or things of the sort to be able to wear certain shoes. So, what this mod does is that it adds a cosmetic (+1 defense, like the Sneakers) version of 11 different shoes to the Adventure's Guild shop. I've only added those that aren't normally obtainable as a reward from the Mine's floors or already sold at the shop. Also includes the Cowboy Boots, which are currently unobtainable. I made it this way so it doesn't feel cheaty.

If you want to contribute to translations, send me the i18n file and I'll include it.

[b]Special note:[/b] 90% of users who download my mods forget to endorse them. If you like this mod, consider endorsing it! It shows appreciation for our efforts and greatly helps me by allowing more people to see it.

1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher;
2. Download this mod & extract [CP] Cosmetic Vanilla Boots folder to Stardew Valley/Mods;
3. Run the game with SMAPI to play.
